name: ChatLinx
source: You have a very special friend... He's there, online, but behind your phone screen. Every text he sends you brings him closer to your heart. You realize that only when you wake up without the familiar sound. No messages... No missed calls... Did something go wrong or you're not the first one he thinks of in the morning?! That's something you'll have to find out on your own.
translation: 你有一位非常特别的朋友……他一直在线，就在手机屏幕的另一端。他发来的每一条消息，都让你们的心靠得更近。直到某天醒来，没有听见熟悉的提示音，你才意识到这一点。没有消息……没有未接来电……是出了什么事，还是你并非他清晨醒来第一个想起的人？！答案，要由你自己去找。
